newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P assigns AA-minus to Bank of Taiwan $200mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns AA-minus to Bank of Taiwan $200mln FRN.

text.p: Standard & Poors ratings agency said on Thursday it assigned AA-minus rating to the state-owned Bank of Taiwan's five-year US$200 million Euro floating rate notes.
The rating reflects Bank of Taiwan's good financial profile and strong market position in Taiwan, as well as the bank's ties to and full ownership by the Taiwan government, the agency said.
The outlook was stable although operating flexibility was constrained by government bureaucracy, it said.
Bank of Taiwan is expected to maintain its strong market position and the established advantages in the increasingly crowded domestic market, it said.
